tasks.question: What is the return deadline in days? Return only JSON with keys "days" (integer) and "source" (passage ID).

tasks.documents:
[P1] Standard items are returnable within 30 days if unused.
[P2] Clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned, even if unused.
[P3] Defective products have a separate repair program.
tasks.question: An unused, non-defective clearance item was delivered 10 days ago. Is it returnable? Return only JSON with keys "eligible" (boolean) and "source" (the decisive passage ID).

tasks.documents:
[P1] January policy: Standard workspaces allow 24 members; Pro workspaces allow 64 members.
[P2] February policy: Pro trials have a limit of 8 members.
[P3] March policy: The paid Pro limit is reduced to 32 members, replacing the January paid Pro limit. Trial limits are unchanged.
tasks.question: Under the latest policy, what is the member limit for a paid Pro workspace that is not on a trial? Return only JSON with keys "limit" (integer) and "source" (decisive passage ID).

tasks.documents:
[P1] A pilot requires an EU region and enabled backups.
[P2] Workspace roster: Aster: EU, backups enabled, 120 active users; Birch: US, backups enabled, 150 active users; Cedar: EU, backups disabled, 200 active users; Dune: EU, backups enabled, 60 active users.
[P3] The pilot also requires at least 100 active users.
tasks.question: Which workspaces meet every pilot requirement? Return only JSON with one key "workspaces", an alphabetically sorted array of names.

tasks.documents:
[P1] The monthly base price is 120 USD and includes 120 requests.
[P2] Each additional request costs 0.08 USD.
[P3] Annual-contract customers receive a 25% discount on the additional-request charges only. The base price is not discounted. No taxes or other charges apply.
tasks.question: An annual-contract customer uses 170 requests in one month. What is the total monthly bill? Return only JSON with one numeric key "total_usd".

tasks.documents:
[P1] The Basic plan costs 15 USD per month and includes email support.
[P2] The Pro plan costs 40 USD per month and includes phone support.
[P3] Both plans allow data export as CSV.
tasks.question: How many hours is the guaranteed Pro phone-support response time? If the documents do not specify it, use null and no sources. Return only JSON with keys "hours" and "sources" (array of passage IDs).

method: Sequential models; fresh model load then warmup; three short and three long 256-token capped requests; six one-shot synthetic RAG checks; greedy decoding; no concurrent inference; GPU sampled every 0.4 seconds. First load has OS caches in their existing state, not a controlled disk-cold load. Repeated prompt prefixes can use Ollama's normal cache.
